Goal `tools-install`: the five sections of `docs/reference/tools/15-install.md` each owe their
feature proofs (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`), and two of the five are complete:
`tools:install/linux-and-macos` and `tools:install/the-layout`. `bun nv proofs --owed --group
tools:install` lists the other three, each owing about, examples, hostile and tests. None owes help
or perf.

Nothing is blocked. One proof found a wrong answer and it is recorded, not fixed:
`data/gaps/nvs-config/a-set-of-a-name-that-is-not-a-key-answers-true.json`, owned by M10. The
attack that found it passes, because the runtime survives every step, so it carries no marker.

A section about a command has its Rust proof where that command is driven through the binary:
`tools:install/the-layout`'s is in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/init.rs`, and `context.modules` now names
that file, `docs/examples/README.md` and `tests/hostile/README.md`, which the pack printed none of.

A `#[cfg(unix)]` test is not compiled on this host and is run by hand in WSL; the playbook's
*Running things* bullet on a crate's `cfg(unix)` half owns the trap. A `#[cfg(windows)]` one runs
here.
